changelog: 0-0-2 gameplay rebuilt from the ground up around a clean racket-sports game concept inspired by Smashing Feathers.
Removed the joystick and four-button control layout in favor of automatic footwork plus swipe-based shot control.
Added perspective pickleball court, automatic player positioning, timing-based contact, directional aiming and shot classification.
Short input produces a dink, upward swipes produce drops or lobs, side swipes create slices/angles, and long swipes drive the ball.
Added new rally AI, ball bounce and net interactions, scoring, swing feedback and cleaner portrait sports-game presentation.
